name: Chutes de la Lobé
description: The Lobé Waterfalls (Chutes de la Lobé) near Kribi are a coastal waterfall site in the South Region. UNESCO lists “The Waterfalls of Lobé, Cameroun” among Cameroon-related World Heritage Centre materials (tentative / associated news), not as an inscribed World Heritage property in the same way as Dja. Practical access fees are not recorded here.
culture: Kribi is a coastal destination in southern Cameroon. The Lobé falls are a nature stop often combined with the town's seaside setting.

name: Plages de Kribi
description: Kribi is a seaside town on Cameroon's Atlantic coast (South Region). The Ministry of Tourism lists coastal / balnéaire tourism among national tourism forms. Named resort prices, hotel ratings and swimming-safety reports are not stored in this knowledge base.
culture: Kribi is one of the best-known coastal stops for travellers in Cameroon. Local fishing communities live along this coast; community details not sourced officially are omitted.
